d0_B_1.quote: I walk in the cold when I want to think, and I smoke Brissago, the cheap ones.

d0_O_1.quote: A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven. That is the only hour I can give you with any confidence.

d1_L_4.quote: I looked at Rosa's kitchen clock when Madame's piano began.

d1_F_0.quote: It has always been troublesome. Aunt Odile was embarrassed for me

d1_F_0.quote: It is my father's silver watch. He died in 1889, and I have never let anyone regulate it, not even Uncle Aurèle. It has always been troublesome.

d1_F_2.quote: The watch has run badly for ten years. I have never let anyone regulate it
d1_F_2.fact: F1 gives only one reading: at the bell's nine, the watch showed twenty to nine. The sheet says nothing about the watch's rate or whether its error is constant.

d0_F_4.quote: What did you hear after that?
